description: This receipt is issued by Gristedes and identifies the store as Gristedes 034, located at 907 8th Avenue & 54th Street, New York, New York. The header contains the Gristedes branding, store number, address, contact telephone number, transaction date and time, cashier name, invoice number, and transaction number. The receipt records the purchase of Byet Ice 8 lbs. The financial section records the net sales amount, applicable 8.875% sales tax, total sales, subtotal, cash amount tendered, and the change returned. The footer records the total number of items purchased and promotes the company's website and social media channels, including Facebook, Twitter, and Foursquare. The overall layout is representative of a United States supermarket POS receipt, combining grocery itemization, sales-tax reporting, cash payment reconciliation, and customer engagement information within a compact retail receipt format.
